🌟 dioramas | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Building interactive, visually stunning 3D landing pages and websites with AI-generated assets.
✨ Key Features: • AI-generated 3D assets (Nano Banana 2 + Meshy 7.1) • Optimized 3D models for web (meshopt, WebP) • three.js based engine with advanced post-processing effects • Scroll-based choreography and interactions • Includes 20 complete example websites
📖 Summary: Dioramas is an open-source framework for creating cinematic, interactive 3D websites. It leverages AI to generate 3D assets from text prompts, which are then optimized and integrated into a three.js engine for visually rich, scroll-driven experiences.
